name: iflow-mcp-clickhouse-mcp-clickhouse

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description:
List available ClickHouse tables in a database, including schema, comment,
row count, and column count.

database.description: The database to list tables from

like.description: Optional LIKE pattern to filter table names

not_like.description: Optional NOT LIKE pattern to exclude table names

page_token.description: Token for pagination, obtained from a previous call

page_size.description: Number of tables to return per page (default: 50)

include_detailed_columns.description:
Whether to include detailed column metadata (default: True).
When False, the columns array will be empty but create_table_query still contains
all column information. This reduces payload size for large schemas.

tools.name: run_select_query
tools.description: Run a SELECT query in a ClickHouse database
